turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My flight got overbooked and they want volunteers to take a later one. Should I do it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It depends on your plans. If you're flexible, you can often get a voucher or cash for it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ask what the compensation is, when the new flight leaves, and whether they'll cover meals or a hotel if it's the next day.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, My work friends want me to host a potluck and I've no clue what to make as the host.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe everything first, and then I'll ask for your thoughts.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could do a huge pot of chili with all the toppings on the side, so people build their own bowls.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a taco bar, which is fun, but it means warming tortillas all evening while people arrive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a couple of big roasted trays, like sausages and vegetables, which basically cook themselves.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Go on, rip them apart.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The chili is my pick, it sits happily on the stove and people can help themselves whenever they turn up. The taco bar is the most fun, but you'd be stuck warming tortillas. The roasting trays are easy too, just less of a centerpiece.
